The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Necus]] had an '''apprentice''' who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the second-floor library of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by another [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Esorr Kayin]]. Necus always suspected Kayin's role in his apprentice's death, but as Kayin was the apprentice of a [[Dark Council]] member, Necus could do nothing until there was evidence confirming Kayin's culpability.
